Drawdown from the Jan 23 ATH ~9.7% (AMBER vs the 10% trigger: prepare, not act; the daily-move trigger of 2.5% is quiet at 0.16%). MACRO (as of Sep 21): SBP policy rate 11.5% (held; last cut/hike history: hiked 100bps earlier in 2026 on Middle-East inflation risk); August CPI 11.1% YoY vs 9.2% in July (SBP data via Trading Economics) — real policy rate is roughly zero, so equities must earn well above ~11.5-12% to beat risk-free; latest T-bill cut-offs I could source (dated ~Jul-Aug 2026, exact auction date unverified): 3m 11.6%, 6m 11.9%, 12m 11.99% — verify at sbp.org.pk. PKR ~277.9-278.4/USD interbank (stable). IMF: fourth EFF review + third RSF review mission (led by Iva Petrova) begins ~Sep 22, staying ~2 weeks into early October, with an Article IV consultation; reports say only a few of 30+ Jan-Jun 2026 targets were met — mild event risk. Oil still ~$100+ with the Middle-East war unresolved. HOLDINGS NEWS (as of Sep 21): NATF FY26 results Sep 18 (see action). FFL: CEO resignation filed on PSX Sep 21 (reason/successor unverified). MUGHAL FY26 results Sep 15: sales Rs 78.0bn, profit Rs 2.49bn, EPS 6.75. GHGL FY26 (Aug 27): sales Rs 48.4bn, profit Rs 7.23bn, EPS 7.23. CPHL EGM Sep 18 approved adding cannabis/hemp activities to its objects clause. BWCL final dividend Rs 10 credited Sep 14. MEBL interim dividend (Rs 8) credited Sep 1. AVN and EFERT: no new filings since the Aug 28 / Aug 21-28 items already known. DATA QUALITY: prices.json stock prices are stale for Sep 21 (equal to Sep 18 close despite a 09:41Z timestamp — scraper needs a look); fund NAVs frozen at Aug 13 (39 days stale); DPS page flags a generic "risk warning" on AVN, SEARL and MUGHAL — treated as unverified boilerplate, not a call driver.

Board also proposed a 5-for-1 share split (233.1M Rs 5 shares into ~1.17bn Rs 1 shares) for the Oct 26 AGM: it changes nothing about value, but after it takes effect your share count x5 and every price/entry level ÷5. In plain words: a good company, priced fairly for its steady earnings, not cheap because of the one-off.

entries.basis: Monthly-timeframe accumulation zones for a 10-25yr horizon: where fundamentals + monthly support align to add in small portions. 'entry' = start nibbling at/below; 'add' = deeper monthly support to load more. Pakistan macro-aware (SBP 11.5%, KSE-100 off the Jan ATH). These are accumulation guides, not precise buy/sell signals — verify with your broker.

MZNPETF.note: Broad Islamic index ETF — your #1 DCA vehicle. Accumulate on any dip; entry is just under fair value, add = deeper monthly support.

MIIETF.note: Second index-ETF leg. Same DCA logic — buy small and often, more at the add level.

MEBL.note: Core compounder but ran up (~544). Start adding on a pullback to ~540; back up the truck at/below Rs 500 (the standing allocation line).

MIF.note: Actively managed Islamic equity fund (NAV-based). Accumulate on monthly dips.

DCR.note: REIT — income play with steady rental dividends. Add for yield near ~38; inflation hedge.

EFERT.note: INCOME, not growth (WATCH). Only add for the yield near ~174; urea glut keeps upside capped — don't overweight.

AIRLINK.note: HIGH BETA, policy-dependent — cap the position. Only small adds near ~125; trim on sharp rallies.

FFL.note: Turnaround, KEEP SMALL. Tiny adds only near ~14.5; take profits if it runs 50%+.

AVN.note: NOT a buy. H1 FY26 swung to a net loss (EPS -0.62); the thesis is broken. This is an exit candidate, not an accumulation — do not average down.

UPFL.note: Only 3 shares (~Rs 74K), illiquid. Exceptional company but immaterial to portfolio decisions — no accumulation plan.
